thread:
riley: Hi! First day docs q: I found the company 'Runbook template' but Duplicate is greyed out. I'm on desktop. Anyone seen this?
devex-bot: Quick checks: 1) Are you in the Redwood workspace? 2) Is the page part of a database template or is the page locked? If locked, only owners can duplicate.
riley: I'm in the right workspace. How do I tell if it's locked or a DB template?
sam: If it's a DB template you usually see it under a database 'Templates' dropdown or the page has a little database icon. If it's locked, hover the title area and you'll see a lock icon or a banner saying "page locked".
riley: I see a little lock banner at the top that says "Locked by emma". Can I request unlocking?
emma: Hey @riley I locked that master copy to prevent accidental edits. Best workflow: duplicate into your My Workspace and then move your copy where you like. I can unlock it briefly if you want to edit in-place.
riley: I still don't get Duplicate even after refreshing.
sam: Two possibilities: 1) Your access is "Can view" only; sharing menu -> Invite -> set to "Can edit". 2) The page is a Template Button or DB template; in that case you need to create a new entry from the DB template rather than duplicating.
kato: Also note mobile hides some controls. If you're on mobile the three-dot menu might be missing. Desktop Chrome/Firefox works best.
emma: @riley I changed your permission to "Can edit" and unlocked the page for 5 minutes. Try again.
riley: Duplicate showed up after that, yay. Quick question: where should I put my duplicated runbook so eng-oncall can access it?
kato: Put operational runbooks in Company Home > Eng > eng-runbooks (shared with eng-oncall). Personal notes and private 1:1s stay in My Workspace or People Ops > Personal 1:1s.
riley: And how do we record doc ownership so folks know who to ping?
sam: We use a tiny doc header block at the top with Owner: <name>, Last updated: <date>, How to duplicate: <one-liner>. Also set the Owner property in the page's metadata if it's a team-managed page.
emma: If owner is unclear, ping #devex or the team channel and attach the page link. We keep a registry for critical runbooks so we can assign backups too.
riley: Thanks all. One last thing: I tried to copy a DB template earlier and ended up copying the whole database by mistake. Any recovery tips?
sam: If you moved it somewhere accidental, Notion history can restore the page. Open the page -> ••• -> Page history and restore the previous version. If it's a duplicate you can just delete it.
riley: Great, thanks. That unlock was clutch :+1:
emma: Welcome aboard Riley! Ping us for more doc setup help.
riley: Will do 44d"
